_comment: Synthetic Phase 4 fixtures (Phase 2 Q4.1/Q4.2). Determination dates and expected deadlines are copied from the pod's AC-09, AC-10 and AC-11 text; all use the 2025 calendar so no input is a future time. Expected values are hand-derived from the AC text, never from an implementation.
